name: com.moondasha/vedic-astrology
title: Moon Dasha Vedic Astrology
description: Vedic astrology: birth charts, 26 vargas, 7 dasha systems, Shadbala, Panchang and Guna Milan.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Look up a birthplace or event place in Moon Dasha's place data and get its place_id, coordinates and IANA time zone. Every Moon Dasha calculation that needs a place takes it as this place_id. Up to five matches, best first.

query.description: The place name, optionally followed by its state or country: "Jaipur", "Springfield Illinois", "Paris France".

tools.name: birth_chart
tools.description: Calculate a Vedic birth chart (D1, sidereal) with Moon Dasha: the ascendant and the nine grahas with sign, degree, whole-sign house, nakshatra and pada, nakshatra lord, dignity, sign lord and the planet's relationship to it, retrograde, combust, Vargottama and Bhavottama flags, and chara karakas (7-karaka scheme), plus a link to the full chart on moondasha.com. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place). If the person does not know the birth time, ask for a best guess and set time_is_approximate. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Required: if the person does not know it, ask for their best guess and set time_is_approximate.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned for the birthplace.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

node.description: Rahu and Ketu by the mean node (default) or the true node.

time_is_approximate.description: Set when the birth time is a guess: the answer then shows the ascendant an hour either side.

chart_style.description: How the chart card draws the chart: North Indian (default) or South Indian. Set south only when the person asks for it.

tools.name: divisional_charts
tools.description: Calculate Vedic divisional charts (vargas) with Moon Dasha: any of the 26 the moondasha.com report draws (D1, D9, D2, D3, D4, D7, D10, D12, D16, D20, D24, D27, D30, D40, D45, D60, D5, D6, D8, D11, D72, D81, D108, D144, D150, D300; default the D9, Navamsa). Each chart gives its Ascendant and the nine grahas with sign, whole-sign house from that chart's own Ascendant, sign lord and relationship, dignity by sign, Vargottama and Bhavottama, what the chart is read for, and the span of birth times that keeps its Ascendant sign, plus a link to the charts on moondasha.com. The higher the division, the more exact the birth time must be: the D60 Ascendant changes sign every few minutes, and the D150's and the D300's within about a minute. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place); set time_is_approximate when the time is a guess. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Required: if the person does not know it, ask for their best guess and set time_is_approximate.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned for the birthplace.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

charts.description: The divisional charts wanted, in order, any of D1, D9, D2, D3, D4, D7, D10, D12, D16, D20, D24, D27, D30, D40, D45, D60, D5, D6, D8, D11, D72, D81, D108, D144, D150, D300 (D1 is the birth chart, for comparison). Default: the D9 (Navamsa) alone.

chart_style.description: How the card draws the charts: North Indian (default) or South Indian. Set south only when the person asks for it.

d2_method.description: The D2 (Hora) scheme: parashara (default; the Sun and Moon horas) or uma_shambhu. Set uma_shambhu only when the person asks for it.

tools.name: strengths
tools.description: Calculate Vedic planet and house strengths with Moon Dasha, as the moondasha.com report computes them: Shadbala (each planet's six-fold strength in virupas and rupas against its required minimum, with Ishta and Kashta Phala), Bhava Bala (each house's strength), Ashtakavarga (bindus by sign for each planet and the Sarvashtakavarga, by Varahamihira's or Parashara's tables), Vimsopaka Bala and Vaiseshikamsa Bala (under the 6, 7, 10 and 16 chart schemes), each with the report's own reading bands, plus a link to them on moondasha.com. Choose with include; all five by default. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place). The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Required: if the person does not know it, ask for their best guess and set time_is_approximate.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned for the birthplace.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

node.description: Rahu and Ketu by the mean node (default) or the true node.

time_is_approximate.description: Set when the birth time is a guess. The strengths are computed for the time given.

include.description: Which strengths to give, any of shadbala (with Ishta and Kashta Phala), bhava_bala (house strength), ashtakavarga, vimsopaka and vaiseshikamsa. Default: all five.

ashtakavarga_method.description: Whose Ashtakavarga tables: varahamihira (default) or parashara. Set parashara only when the person asks for Parashara's tables.

tools.name: dasha_periods
tools.description: Calculate Vedic dasha periods with Moon Dasha in any of seven systems: Vimshottari (default), Yogini, Ashtottari, Chara (K. N. Rao), Kaal Chakra, Narayana and Sudarshan Chakra. Returns the Mahadashas with their dates to the 120th year of life, across cycles (Sudarshan Chakra: the 12 years of the running cycle), the Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantardasha running on a given day (default today; Sudarshan Chakra: the year and its month), and the running Mahadasha's Antardashas, plus a link to the dashas on moondasha.com. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place). If the person does not know the birth time, ask for a best guess and set time_is_approximate. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

tools.name: panchang
tools.description: Calculate the Vedic panchang (Hindu almanac) of a day at a place with Moon Dasha: the weekday; tithi, nakshatra, yoga and karana with their change times; the Moon's sign; the lunar month (Amanta and Purnimanta); sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset; Rahu Kaal, Gulikai Kalam, Yamaganda, Dur Muhurtam, Abhijit Muhurat, Vijaya Muhurta, Amrit Kalam and Brahma Muhurta; the 24 horas; planets changing sign or nakshatra that day; and when the next Purnima, Amavasya and Ekadashis run. No Choghadiya or festival dates. Needs the place (a place_id from find_place); the date defaults to today there, and the answer then also says what is running now. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today at the place, by its own clock; the answer then also says what is running now.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned for the place.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

node.description: Rahu and Ketu by the mean node (default) or the true node.

sunrise.description: Which sunrise opens the day: apparent (the default, as moondasha.com times it: the upper limb with refraction) or classical (the centre of the disc on the true horizon, without refraction).

tools.name: planetary_positions
tools.description: Calculate where the planets stand in the sidereal zodiac at a moment with Moon Dasha: the nine grahas with sign, degree, nakshatra and pada, dignity, retrograde and combust, when each entered its sign and when it leaves; the retrograde run of Mercury to Saturn, current or next; the ascendant when a place is given; the Moon's tithi, phase and how much of it is lit. Default: now. For another moment give a date (and a time), on the clock of the place (a place_id from find_place) or of a time_zone alone; UTC when neither is given. Set outer_planets only when the reader asks about Uranus, Neptune or Pluto. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, on the clock of the place or time_zone (UTC without either). Leave out date and time for now.

time.description: The time of day on that clock, 24-hour HH:MM. Default 12:00 when a date is given; with no date, today at that time.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned, for the ascendant and the local clock. Optional: without a place the answer has no ascendant.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. "Asia/Kolkata", for its clock alone, without a place or an ascendant. Leave it out when giving a place_id, whose own clock is used.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

node.description: Rahu and Ketu by the mean node (default) or the true node.

outer_planets.description: Also list Uranus, Neptune and Pluto. Set it only when the reader asks about them.

tools.name: compatibility
tools.description: Match two people's Vedic charts with Moon Dasha: Guna Milan (Ashtakoota) out of 36 with each koota's points, the koota doshas and the Muhurta Chintamani conditions that lift them; each person's Mangal Dosha (outside the 36); and Dual Cosmodyne, a Western synastry score with its strongest aspects. Each score stands on its own. Needs both people's birth dates, local birth times and birthplaces (place_ids from find_place). Guna Milan reads one person as the groom and one as the bride, so it needs to know who is the man and who is the woman: ask if the person has not said, and set groom to the man's letter. With no genders given, or for a couple of the same sex, person A takes the groom's seat. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. A score shows how two charts agree by tradition, not whether a relationship will succeed; never treat it as a reason not to marry, never read Nadi as a medical or genetic test, and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

tools.name: yogas
tools.description: List the yogas and doshas in a Vedic chart with Moon Dasha's yoga engine: each formed yoga and dosha with its strength (Moon Dasha's 0 to 5 index, not a probability), how it formed in this chart, any cancellations, its meaning and the planets whose periods it shows most in; weak yogas by name; cancelled doshas with what cancelled them; and the named doshas that are not present, such as Mangal Dosha or Kala Sarpa. Reads the birth chart (D1) or a divisional chart (varga). Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place). The findings are Moon Dasha's calculations; interpret them as tendencies and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

tools.name: sade_sati
tools.description: Find Sade Sati for a birth with Moon Dasha's calculations: whether it is running, its three phases (Rising, Peak, Setting) and their exact dates, and when the next one comes; also Kantaka Shani and Ashtama Shani (Saturn in the 4th and 8th signs from the Moon, called Dhaiya) and the Saturn Return, over the person's life. Counted by sign from the natal Moon sign. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place). Describe these periods as stretches of pressure and responsibility, never misfortune, and suggest no remedies; never predict death, illness, accidents, a relative's death, markets or court cases.

tools.name: transits
tools.description: Follow Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu against a Vedic birth chart with Moon Dasha's calculations, over a window (two years from today by default): each sign stay with its dates, the house it transits from the Ascendant and from the Moon, its dignity, its Ashtakavarga points and Moon Dasha's rating of the stay (its own reading, not a probability), the classical good houses from the Moon, the houses it aspects, its stations, the exact days it passes natal planets, and any dasha of that planet the person runs meanwhile; and the transit chart, the nine planets now beside the natal ones, from the Ascendant and from the Moon. Sade Sati's phases and dates come from sade_sati. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place). Word transits as tendencies; never predict death, illness, accidents, a relative's death, markets, elections or court cases.
